question: What enduring protection is requested from the hrīṃ-formed goddess?
premises: The goddess is associated with the syllable hrīṃ.
She is identified as the beautiful one of Śambhu.
Protection is requested at all times.
inference: The hrīṃ-formed goddess, beautiful consort of Śambhu, is asked for constant protection.
plain_english: May the goddess formed of the syllable hrīṃ, the beautiful one of Śambhu, always protect me.
